logline: Defying Alexander's desperate pleas, Juliana crawls barehanded into the razor-sharp blackthorn garden, enduring brutal lacerations under Clarissa and Gerald's cruel taunts until she unearths the lost emerald signet ring.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 12's climax where Juliana demanded to know where the frozen blackthorn garden was located to save Alexander from the gallows.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Panting, Praying)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Please, ring... you have to be here.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Juliana continues clawing forward, branches lacerating her arm and cheek.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Juliana digs her torn fingers into the frost-hardened earth, turning over rocks and dead vegetation.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Her blood-smeared index finger brushes against a solid metallic object half-buried in the frozen dirt beneath a thorny branch.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Juliana reaches out her torn, bloodied hand and wraps her fingers tightly around the emerald ring.
